resolvedBlockers.resolution: ROOT CAUSE: elevenlabs.py processed BOTH committed_transcript AND committed_transcript_with_timestamps. Fix: process only committed_transcript_with_timestamps, skip the other. Added text-based dedup safety net.
VAD silence_threshold 0.8→1.5s (Arabic mid-sentence pauses), vad_threshold 0.4→0.5. Avg segment went from single-word to 33.8 words.
Improved system prompt, increased timeouts, mixed-script detection + retry, fragment filter (<2 words AND <5 chars), non-Arabic text skip. Validated: 34/35 clean Hebrew on 532s file.
ROOT CAUSE: elevenlabs.py only handled committed_transcript_with_timestamps, ignored committed_transcript. Fixed in 602468d but introduced 2x duplication. Now re-fixed in 681f838.
Primary timeout 5s→10s, fallback 8s→15s. 123-word segment was timing out GPT-5.2 at 5s. Increased timeouts don't affect fast responses.

A/B tested VAD 1.5s vs 2.0s. 1.5s wins: more granular segments (44 vs 34), faster latency (1685ms vs 1929ms), safer max segment (62 vs 95 words). Both 100% clean Hebrew. Context window 3→5 improves coherence.
Bypassed RBAC with publish profile credentials + Python urllib for Kudu zipdeploy. SCM basic auth re-enabled via ARM REST API.
File-based JSON persistence at /home/data/evaluation-rules.json on Azure. Auto-detects Azure vs local. Load on startup, save on every CRUD mutation.

recentDecisions.rationale: 1.5s gives more granular real-time segments (44 vs 34), 14% lower latency, smaller max segment (62 vs 95 words). Both produce 100% clean Hebrew.
More Hebrew context in translation prompt improves coherence across segments
123-word segment was timing out at 5s. Avg latency 2s for 18-word segments = ~7s for 123 words. Timeouts don't slow fast responses.

recentDecisions.decision: All tuning params configurable via env vars
recentDecisions.rationale: Enables A/B testing via az webapp config without code redeploy. Params: VAD_SILENCE_THRESHOLD_SECS, VAD_THRESHOLD, CONTEXT_WINDOW_SIZE, PRIMARY_MODEL, PRIMARY_TIMEOUT_MS, FALLBACK_MODEL, FALLBACK_TIMEOUT_MS
Both events fire for every utterance when include_timestamps=true. Processing both = 2x duplication. with_timestamps has word-level timing data.

recentDecisions.decision: Fragment filter: skip <2 words AND <5 chars, skip non-Arabic text
recentDecisions.rationale: Fragments waste LLM tokens and pollute context window with garbage

recentDecisions.decision: File-based JSON persistence for evaluation rules (no database)
recentDecisions.rationale: Azure /home/ is persistent across restarts/redeploys. Simple JSON file at /home/data/evaluation-rules.json. No database needed for MVP.

recentDecisions.decision: Python urllib for Kudu zipdeploy in CI/CD
recentDecisions.rationale: Bash curl with publish profile credentials fails due to $ expansion in username. Python urllib.request avoids shell escaping entirely.

vadSweep.reason: More granular segments, 14% lower latency, safer max segment size

Mixed-script detection: check for Arabic chars in Hebrew output
ffmpeg in startup.sh for audio format conversion

toAvoid: Processing both committed_transcript event types (causes 2x duplication)
VAD silence_threshold below 1.5s for Arabic (cuts mid-sentence)
VAD silence_threshold above 2.0s for Arabic (no quality gain, worse latency)
Translating single-char/single-word fragments (garbage output, pollutes context)
Closing WebSocket on rate limit — drop chunk instead
Claiming deployed without verifying with real audio files
Assuming root cause without production log evidence
Silent code paths with zero logging
Python .format() on user-generated text containing curly braces
Bash curl with Azure publish profile credentials ($ in username breaks)
Using RBAC service principal when SCM basic auth is available
